description: One run of the CI for a pushed commit: a snapshot, not a log. The queue writes it when the push arrives and replaces the same record when the run ends, because a run's transitions are the machine's own state, not a decision a person made and an audit trail has to keep. The record key is the run's id: it names one machine, not an order.

main.description: One run, as the Durable Object holds it.

repo.description: The repo's name, which a person reads.

repoId.description: The repo's identity: a name can be reused, this cannot.

target.description: The commit the run is about.

before.description: What the ref was before the push, when the gateway said.

status.description: Where the machine is: it waits, it runs, it is over.

outcome.description: How it ended, once `status` is `done`: the command's verdict, or the run never getting to run.

exitCode.description: The command's exit code, when there was one.

log.description: The tail of what the run said — a tail, because a record is not a log file.

endedAt.description: When it stopped, when it did.
